snapshot.text: Public system with health insurance (CNAMGS) and run-down hospitals, especially outside Libreville. The health ministry's reform plan targets dilapidated hospitals, missing specialists, better patient reception and fairer access across regions.

priorities.title: Hospital and staffing plan
priorities.text: A plan for dilapidated hospitals, absent specialists and patient care, including more staff in public facilities.

priorities.title: Health departments
priorities.text: Gabon is making its health departments operational as a decentralisation reform.

priorities.title: Cuban doctors
priorities.text: 18 Cuban doctors are expected under a strengthened partnership with Cuba.
